AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted campus safety coordinator or administrator record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when admin record was provisioned

SafetyReport.title: SafetyReport
SafetyReport.description: Crowdsourced Panjab University campus dark spot or safety concern report.

title.description: Short summary title of the safety concern

corridorName.description: Campus road, hostel stretch, or building area name

severity.description: Urgency level of the safety concern

status.description: Current resolution state with PU authorities

description.description: Detailed student observation of the dark spot or safety risk

cctvPhase3Candidate.description: Whether the spot needs a Phase-3 CCTV camera

peakRiskWindow.description: Time window when students face the highest risk

upvotes.description: Number of students who confirmed they walk this stretch

placeSearchQuery.description: Google Maps Places search query within Panjab University

secondarySearchQuery.description: Optional secondary landmark query for corridor midpoint

lat.description: Latitude within Panjab University Chandigarh jurisdiction (30.735 to 30.770)

lng.description: Longitude within Panjab University Chandigarh jurisdiction (76.745 to 76.780)

formattedAddress.description: Resolved address from Google Maps Places API

sourceCitation.description: Reference to Times of India report or student audit batch

officialRemarks.description: Remarks on escalation or repair status

authorId.description: Anonymous device ID of the student who created the report

isPublic.description: Flag indicating the campus safety report is publicly readable

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when report was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when report was last updated

FieldObservation.title: FieldObservation
FieldObservation.description: Student comment or confirmation note attached to a campus safety report.

reportId.description: ID of the parent safety report

authorId.description: Anonymous device ID of the student submitting the observation

authorRole.description: Student hostel or department affiliation label (non-PII)

note.description: Student observation note about the dark stretch

isPublic.description: Flag indicating the observation is publicly readable

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when observation was recorded

VoteRecord.title: VoteRecord
VoteRecord.description: One-vote-per-device lock record preventing duplicate +1 taps on the same report.

reportId.description: ID of the parent safety report

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the vote was cast

/admins/{adminId}.description: Stores verified administrator UIDs for Panjab University safety audit coordinators.

/reports/{reportId}.description: Stores Panjab University campus dark spot and safety hazard reports.

/reports/{reportId}/observations/{observ.description: Stores student field observations and confirmation comments for a specific report.

/reports/{reportId}/votes/{deviceId}.description: Stores one-vote-per-device deduplication locks for each safety report.
